title: Jessica Simpson Shares Her Side of Run-In With Ex-Husband Nick Lachey - NewsBreak
text:
By Marissa Dow ,
1 hours ago Watch: Nick Lachey Details Run-In With Ex Jessica Simpson on Flight 20 Years After Divorce. Jessica Simpson finds setting the record straight irresistible. The “Take My Breath Away” singer addressed recent claims made by her ex-husband Nick Lachey, who detailed their unexpected run-in on a flight to Hawaii and recounted how she sat in first class as her three kids—Maxwell, 14, Ace, 12 and Birdie, 7—flew in a "separate class of service" with their dad Eric Johnson.
